reply_text:
I replied to Bettina in #coastal-team's thread. I did not set up the recurring digest: this run has no scheduling tool, so nothing is scheduled and nothing has been posted.

My reply told her two things to settle first:
- **#coastal-random content:** anything from that channel posted into #coastal-team would be visible to everyone in #coastal-team, so the digest either only includes items already visible there, or it goes somewhere both audiences can see.
- **Open customer items:** finance figures (rates, contract values, invoices, payment terms) stay out of the channel unless Anselm Grieve or June Osei-Lark approve. Seat counts, renewal dates and ticket numbers are fine.

Once she picks an option for the first point and a scheduler is available, the Monday 08:00 digest can be set up, starting the Monday after she confirms.
